correction: To borrow (also called regrouping) means: when a top digit is too small to subtract, take 1 from the next higher place on the left.
why: "also called borrowing" gives the same word back as its own alternative name, which is vacuous; the standard second name for this operation is "regrouping" (contrast C6's plain gerund gloss "To simplify (simplifying)").
